name: Central Andes (Aconcagua)
region: Subtropical Andes of Argentina and Chile; also Ojos del Salado (drier).
sources: Garreaud, R. (2009) The Andes climate and weather. Advances in Geosciences 22
Aconcagua Provincial Park weather records (Plaza de Mulas)
Hersbach, H. et al. (2020) The ERA5 global reanalysis. QJRMS 146:1999-2049 (monthly climatology 1991-2020, 300 hPa winds)
notes: Dry: most precipitation falls as winter snow. Summer 'viento blanco' storms bring hurricane-force winds and spindrift.
